hints.content: Sathish pays for all of the gas when he is alone in the car, and he pays for $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of the gas when his friends are with him.

Sathish travels $300\,\text{km}$ alone. The car consumes $6$ liters of gas for every $100$ kilometers.

$300\,\cancel{\text{km}}\times \dfrac{6\,\text{L}}{100\,\cancel{\text{km}}}=18\,\text{L}$

Sathish uses $18\,\text{L}$ of gas when he is alone.

Gas costs $\$1.20$ per liter.

$18\,\cancel{\text{L}} \times 1.20\dfrac{\$}{\cancel{\text{L}}}=\$21.60$

Sathish pays $\$21.60$ for gas when he is alone in the car.

There are $3$ people in the car for $1800\,\text{km}$ because $2100-2\times 150=1800$.

$1800\,\cancel{\text{km}}\times \dfrac{6\,\text{L}}{100\,\cancel{\text{km}}}=108\,\text{L}$

Sathish uses $108\,\text{L}$ of gas when his friends are in the car.

$108\,\cancel{\text{L}} \times 1.20\dfrac{\$}{\cancel{\text{L}}}=\$129.60$

Sathish and his $2$ friends split the cost of the $\$129.60$ worth of gas equally.

$129.60\times \dfrac{1}{3}=43.20$

Sathish pays $\$43.20$ for gas when his friends are in the car.
Sathish will pay a total of $\$64.80$ for gas.

question.content:
Sathish is going on a $2100$-kilometer road trip with $2$ friends, whom he will pick up $150$ kilometers after he begins the trip and drop off when there are $150$ kilometers remaining. The car consumes $6$ liters of gas for every $100$ kilometers, and gas costs $\$1.20$ per liter.

Sathish will pay for all of the gas when he is alone in the car, but he and his friends will split the cost evenly when they are together.

**How much will Sathish pay for gas?**
